system.description:
You are driven to be free of the traps of your past. This could be fleeing from fellow cult members, your debts or crimes, or your personal demons.

Source of Inspiration: A Way Out. Whenever you feel trapped, you draw on your inner resolve to find a way forward. You gain inspiration whenever you find a path forward from a physical, mental, or emotional trap or dead end.

Find a secret door or hidden path in an apparent dead end, defeat or escape from those pursuing you or trying to deceive you, escape from or avoid being bound or imprisoned by ropes, nets, chains, or bars.

Inspiration Feature: Self-Motivation. You can spend your inspiration to add your proficiency bonus to a Wisdom or Charisma saving throw if not proficient, or add an expertise die if already proficient.

Fulfilling Your Destiny

You fulfill your destiny of Escape by ending the source of whatever trapped you.

Confess to your crimes and accept punishment, expose or defeat an organization responsible for trapping you, pay your debts (with interest), find inner peace.

Fulfillment Feature: The Truth Shall Set You Free. You gain an expertise die on Insight checks vs lies and on Sleight of Hand checks to escape bondage or imprisonment.

In addition, you can use your @UUID[Compendium.a5e.a5e-destiny-features.Item.Q4YRwWI5pYnSF0yi]{Self-Motivation} feature once per long rest without spending inspiration.
